title: Latency vs Cost Tuner — prototype, ops feedback & QA handoff
creator: Arielle Park
description:
Purpose: ship an interactive Console control that lets platform and product teams tune latency/cost tradeoffs for a given rollout or model route. The control surfaces recommended presets (Low latency, Balanced, Low cost), a continuous slider for fine-tuning, and inline predictions for expected p50/p95 latency and monthly cost delta. This ticket covers the visual prototype, ops/SRE feedback iteration, microcopy and motion redlines, accessibility checks, and final QA dev handoff.

Goals:
- Make tradeoffs understandable to non-infra engineers via clear visuals and predicted impact.
- Prevent dangerous configurations by surfacing guardrails and simulated traffic outcomes.
- Provide tight handoff assets (Figma + motion tokens + copy + acceptance criteria) for engineering to implement.

Out of scope: autoscale policies, per-customer pricing changes, backend model routing implementation details (ENG will map fields to runtime config).
comments: 2026-02-21 — Arielle Park: Initial exploration submitted. Two variants in Figma: (A) compact slider + sparkline for expected p50/p95 and cost; (B) stacked presets with an expandable detailed simulation. Leaving notes about preferred microcopy and guardrail tooltip content.

2026-02-24 — SRE (Jordan Lee): Ops feedback — prefer explicit simulation step for changes that could remove caching. Suggested adding an estimate of affected requests/min under typical load. Also requested a flag to mark changes as 'simulation only' until applied by infra team.

2026-02-28 — Miguel Santos: Design review w/ PM & ENG. Decided to prioritize Variant A (compact slider) for the first pass to reduce visual complexity. Action: add a secondary 'Advanced' panel that surfaces simulation controls and exact runtime toggles. Assigned ENG to validate API fields for predicted metrics (ENG-27843).

2026-03-03 — Accessibility review (Riley Chen): Contrast for the slider handle and sparkline annotations needs improvement. Suggested hit target >= 44px for the slider handle and keyboard-only preview state. Also flagged color-blind safe palette for positive/negative cost delta indicators.

2026-03-05 — Prototype testing (Design Research): 6 participants moderated session. Key finding: users understood presets faster than the continuous slider; however, the slider was preferred by infra engineers for fine control. Recommendation: keep presets as defaults and surface slider as 'Custom'. Update microcopy to explain what each preset optimizes for in one sentence.

2026-03-07 — Engineering questions (ENG-27843 thread): Devs asked for the exact expected output schema (latency_p50, latency_p95, monthly_cost_delta, simulated_requests_affected). I uploaded a Confluence appendix with the sample JSON and fallback behavior for missing fields.

2026-03-09 — Motion spec (Arielle Park): Attached Lottie and cubic-bezier tokens; animation for slider thumb snap, sparkline transition and the guardrail toast were specified. Motion durations: 120ms for micro-interactions, 320ms for panel expand/collapse. Added token names to Figma file.

2026-03-11 — PM sign-off (Hannah Iyer): Reviewed and approved copy and acceptance criteria. PM requested metric tracking for 'tuner opened' and 'preset applied' events so the team can measure adoption and regression risk. Added analytics event names to handoff doc.

2026-03-12 — QA handoff (Miguel Santos): Handoff pack uploaded. Acceptance criteria: 1) visual parity with Figma for compact and advanced states; 2) keyboard navigation for slider and presets; 3) ARIA labels for live predicted values; 4) simulated run produces expected analytics events. Linked GH PR for initial implementation for design review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4821
next_steps: Resolve accessibility contrast and hit-target updates, finalize API contract with ENG by 2026-03-15, and merge design comments into GH PR. Schedule dev handoff demo the week of 2026-03-16.
acceptance_criteria: Compact tuner matches Figma pixel-for-pixel in both light/dark modes
Presets (Low latency, Balanced, Low cost) apply expected default parameter sets
Slider exposes live predicted p50/p95 and cost delta; values update at 200–400ms after input
Advanced panel shows simulation controls and estimated affected requests/min
Keyboard and screen-reader accessible with ARIA labels for dynamic values
Analytics events fired: tuner_opened, tuner_preset_applied, tuner_custom_adjusted, tuner_simulation_run
